answer: Anyone as a result has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 46 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The kernel counter is kept in oasis and nadir makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 46 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Each duplicate costs another 109 dollars in locked collateral and another 7 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
